system.description:
EARTH SOUL UTILITY WARDING
Tradition verdant
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Targets 1 willing creature
Duration 10 minutes

The target's body and soul become spiritually anchored to the living world.
While standing upon natural earth, stone or living vegetation, the target gains:
Advantage on saving throws against possession;
a +4-status bonus to saving throws against unwanted Teleportation or effects that would forcibly move its soul;
Advantage on checks and saving throws made to resist being Shoved, Tripped or physically moved against its will.
If an effect would forcibly teleport or possess the target without allowing a saving throw, that effect must first successfully Counteract Rooted Soul. The spell provides no benefit while the target is flying, swimming without touching the ground or otherwise completely separated from the natural world.

Warping Options:
+1 PP: Affect one additional target.
+4 PP: The target retains the benefits while within 10 feet of natural ground rather than requiring direct contact. 1049-179500

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. Advantage against possession and against being moved, and +4 status against soul-moving Teleportation, are scoped rows on the target — while it stands on natural ground.
